evidence_kind: Pinned primary compiled implementation plus task-owned Java and XML declarations

facts.fact: An empty value buffer returns Java null; empty quoted text is not an omission instruction.
Nonnull scalar input is stored in the row data map; SQL staging and header inclusion still govern the emitted XML.
CSV attribute/header mappings determine included XML attributes independently of each scalar cell's null value.
The transform marks its dynamic VOs with XML_EXPLICIT_NULL=true before XML writing.
An included null value under explicit-null mode renders an element with null=true.
An element marked null=true reads as Java null.
Absent XML scalars are skipped; present changed values, including explicit null, reach the attribute setter list. Non-updateable VO attributes are skipped.

Alternate-key matches reuse existing primary keys; supported single globally-unique primary-key definitions generate IDs on a miss and propagate matching association keys to nested children. No client ID is needed or admitted.

Primary-key lookup supplies the existing row or null; a null row invokes createAndInitRow/createRow before XML attribute application. This generic create path does not establish every entity's defaults.
For persistent attributes, incoming null and current null returns no pending setter update; non-null create values and changed explicit nulls still apply.

qualified_use: Wholly new GENERIC/SINGLE Per Diem policy groups only; explicit no-determinant SINGLE/SUMUP/TIME_SINGLE/TIME_SUMUP formula choices.
Explicit parent DRAFT/GENERIC/SINGLE/disabled determinant scope values. Require business include/deduction/conversion/currency/formula choices; do not use EO/UI defaults.
Explicit ANCHOR/time row subtype and customer dates. ANCHOR VALID and other admitted rate kinds DRAFT follow own doCreate/helperCreateLine. Formula prefix derives TimeBasedRateModelFlag.

New STANDARD/SAME time range lower coordinates follow own helperSyncHourMin starting0:0, for distinct upper hours. OTHER_STANDARD lower synchronization has no joined caller and is create-pending. All child dates share the explicit ANCHOR dates. No creation for existing policy or ambiguous equal-hour tie order.

New code-based deduction value rows are exact consumer serialization of doSyncDeduction/doSyncAccomDeduction relationships, never assumed FSM UI-side generation; no implementor-owned value-row target.
All three owning VOs mark five audit inputs non-updateable; parent/line/value globally unique IDs and associations are server-owned. CSV does not carry ObjectVersionNumber.

Included blank persistent scalars already null are skipped by the ADF reader. New value DeterminantValue is persistent, has no create/default initializer and stays null; its setter therefore does not erase the supplied code. Inactive role-threshold coordinates are likewise both persistent null.

Raw geography accessors short-circuit null. The service reference-comparison branch is joined by fsm-dom-empty-element-contract.json only for the pinned default Oracle provider/no-child explicit-null path. Child currency inheritance is suppressed in Service migration. AccomNightRate BaseRate side effect only applies to excluded ACCOMMODATIONS subtype, not admitted ANCHOR/STANDARD/SAME.
boundaries: Source-qualified local create preparation for the admitted shapes; native target create, provider/build parity and persisted-state qualification remain unverified.
No Rate Determinants, independent value target, existing range rekey/synchronization, dormant MEALS percentage component, OTHER_STANDARD lower synchronization or equal-hour minute tie-order creation.
Existing Per Diem field-specific update decisions remain unchanged. Ordinary operation-bound lookups/currency, public validation/native approval and fresh-export verification remain mandatory.

shared_evidence_assessment.proof: fsm-dom-empty-element-contract.json joins the pinned default Oracle provider/no-child explicit-null identity path.
shared_evidence_assessment.meaning: Earlier frozen holds remain historical. Target provider/build parity and live creation are unverified; no hard check or approval gate is waived.
